attributes.additional_details: Council Tax bills include a specific charge for environmental services, waste, and street upkeep. Yet residents on estates and in flats are forced to pay mandatory service charges for area maintenance and clearing illegal fly-tipping because councils class their communal land as "private."

rejection.details:
We find your petition unclear - there is a request in the title but this is directly the responsibility of each local authority. There is no clear request in the text of the petition calling on the Government or Parliament to act.

If you have any issues with the council tax rate set by your local council (and any other charges they set) then you can contact your local councillor (or local MP).
